description: Train the AI agent by adding a knowledge source. type='url' crawls a website (up to 50 pages, fewer when the workspace knowledge-base quota is nearly full); type='qa' stores a single question/answer pair. Ingestion is asynchronous, the source starts as PENDING; poll `list_knowledge` for READY status.

type.description: 'url' to crawl a website, or 'qa' to add a question/answer pair.

url.description: Website root URL to crawl. Required when type='url'.

name: add_knowledge
title: Add knowledge
